name: dispatch-skills
description: Dispatch turns the host agent into an end-to-end orchestrator across native subagents and cross-platform CLI delegates—catching flawed assumptions early and verifying delivery with minimal routine human coordination.

scripts.maintain: node scripts/maintain.ts && npm run hashes && npm test
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node scripts/maintain.ts --check && node scripts/generate-hashes.ts --check && node scripts/check-terms.ts && node scripts/validate-configs.ts && node scripts/path-bytes.ts && node --test --import=./tests/helpers/isolated-temp.ts --import=./tests/helpers/block-spawn.ts --test-reporter=./scripts/test-reporter.ts --test-concurrency=8 "tests/{unit,integration,tooling}/**/*.test.ts"
